buildCommand: curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain stable --no-modify-path && . "$HOME/.cargo/env" && rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION=$(grep -A1 'name = "wasm-bindgen"' example-app/Cargo.lock | grep version | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)".*/\1/') && cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version "$WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION" --locked && npm run build:plugin && npm run build
